book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: 1 CORINTHIANS PAUL AN FEF AINAUIN IGAYAM CORINTH YANGAN AURIS

content: Keriso Rabob emon Imisir Men
Yau taitaiu tutuau, yau agogoi Wasagobin omi aurim akurereb aurin on ami not anrubunagen omi mamaba wasagobin wobo, ato on nan ami baitutumai wofaskikin aurin on.
Atonio wasagobin emon on omi woyawas, on mes omi atonio dura aurim akurereb on nana wonbokikin. Ato ambin on, omi ami baitutum on men er yabin auman on.
Yabin yau on Bada mamaba ibibebeyiu on nanaba on omi aurim ayayabonai, atonio dura on gagamin bag: Keriso on ot aurit irabob ati bokomas fasinai, God an dura buk amonai min on nanaba sigayam,
On irabob sigarobai, ato ra baitoninai on imisir men, on nanaba God an dura buk amonai sigayam,
ato On Peter aurin irobotet, namon baiyoyobotis auyotoat nimtereban ruam auris ba irobotet,
on gibunai wera kaitamomai wat on, On taitait tutuat engon 500 on tefanai nanaba auris irobotet, ato osi sabu engon tutufin min ari semama, ato sabu fani wat on sirabob.
Namon On James aurin irobotet, weie On baiyoyobotis engon auris irobotet,
ato au kanfoun bag on yau mat auriu irobotet, yau on ato fifi kafakakai ba, ayon men enonosin on an wera ibo nono fifi inituai, baise on asir ebisafurai mom, on bobo nanaba on yau auriu imatar.
Baiyoyobotis engon babasi bag on yau, ato yau on men fofoniu on sabu sinyoreu baiyoyobotiu, yabin yau on God an ekalesia engon baikokosar aites on mes.

Baise God an kaber emon on yau ari ibaisiu anat ibobouniu men, on nanaba amama ato On an kaber yau auriu on men wagat wat on. Ambin, yau on bobo aboen kwakwan baiyoyobotis fani aigiseires—baise men yau bobo aboen on, ab God an kaber on yau bisiwui ibobo.
Mamaba yau on dura omi aurim akurereb o osi baiyoyobotis fani dura omi aurim sikurereb, baise wei engon on dura kaitamom on nana sabu auris wakurereb, ato omi on dura wobo wobitutum.
Sabu Rabobis Sinmisiririn Men
Baise ot ati wasagobin takurereb tau, God on Keriso rabob emon ibobaimisirai men, ato sabu fani omi sanamui mamaba sebikakafun sau, orot jever men iyafan tani arimon rabob emon inmisir men on?
Sabu men rabob emon sitmisiririn men on, God on men meyan Keriso rabob emon itbobaimisirai men on.
On tefanai, Keriso men rabob emon itmisir men on, wei ai dura wakurereb on arimon yabin wagan wat, a omi ami baitutum mat on eb arimon yabin ambin.

On tefanai, wei on dura baisigogo God aurin watkurereb on arimon omi rerebai wotitei wotsagob, yabin wei dura wakurereb wau on God on Keriso rabob emon ibobaimisirai. Baise God on Keriso men rabob emon itbobaimisirai on, sabu arimon men rabob emon sitmisiririn on.
Ato God men sabu rabob emon men itbobaimisires on, Keriso mat men rabob emon itbobaimisirai on.
On tefanai, God men Keriso rabob emon itbobaimisirai on, omi ami baitutum on arimon yabin ambin; ato ami bokomas on nana si’ten.
Mat, osi sabu iyabon Keriso sibitutumai sirarabob nono on arimon sitsiwan.

Ato ot dura bagai Keriso tamomousin on ari atonio tafanam an yawasai wat on, ato ot uwat on men sinoubibiro on, sabu bokomasotis arimon ot aurit on men sunub siniyababan ato sinau, “Osi asi baitutum on yabin wagan wat.”
Baise dura bag God on Keriso rabob emon ibobaimisirai men, ato God an sabu ato sirarabob amosi on Keriso ainau ibobaimisirai iyawas men ato arimon men gibui inarab men.
Yabin orot kaitamom ifour on rabob on emon ne inat, on eta kaitamomai orot tani ifour on sabu sinarab ato arimon rabob emon sinmisiririn men.
Sabu engon serarabob yabin Adam on God aurin ifonaseir on mes, on eta kaitamomai Keriso on God aurin ifonabo on mes, osi sabu On mat sibikaita on engon arimon sinyawas men.

Baise God arimon sabu on an etaiai wat infouris rabob emon sinmisiririn sinyawas men: God on ainau Keriso ifourai iyawas men; ato Keriso innanat men on, sabu iyabon On ebinoanis arimon sinmisir sinyawas men.
Namon tafanam kanfoun arimon innat, Keriso on arimon tafanam an bainetewarotis, an babadis, an faiwarotis on engon inikomasis, ato gibui on Baiaiwab inboai God Taman initai.
Keriso on arimon nana inbiAiwab weie God arimon an ragit engon inbomerubes On an baibad babanai sinama.
On an ragit kanfoun on rabob, on arimon inikomasai.

God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, “God on bobo engon tutufin on Keriso an baibad babanai iya.” Dura ato iyau, “Bobo engon tutufin,” On an baibad babanai iya, ato on dura on rerebai tanitai God on men Toun mat ibobarai iyau on, ab On bobo engon tutufin ibo Keriso an baibad babanai iya.

Baise on an ra bobo engon tutufin Keriso an baibad babanai sinaya ato Toun Natun on God babanai inama, bobo engon tutufin min On an baibad babanai sinaya, onai God on bobo engon tutufin tefasi ininetewar.

Ato sabu rabob emon men sinmisiririn on, ato sabu mamaba sinafour? Sabu fani sirabob ato asi garamin osi weines sibibapataitois on? Ato sabu rabobis men sinmisiririn on, aibo mes sabu weines on sebibapataitois?
Ato ot aurit on, aibo mes yawas beruber komasin amonai tabiwanit, ato wera kakaita kakaita amosi nan? Ato God men sabu itbobaimisires on.

Yau taitaiu tutuau, yau on ra fufur sabu sebiragiteu ra tani arimon anarab, ato yau dura bag awurem omi aurim on ataseseir yabin omi on Keriso Iesu ati Bada ebinoanai on mes, atonio on dura bag wat awurem.

Yau nin Ephesus mafam gagaminai nan on au bobo aurin afofourtobon baise sabu on yau sebiragiteu, osi on rega foro tutuenis ba sefofour, ato yau arimon aifan baiyan obin nin tafanamai anboai? Sabu rabobis men sinmisiririn men on, ato sabu engon dura sau sebikakafun ba on tanigibubunuai,

content.text: “Ot on asir bayu tanam tanatom mom, ato raso tanarab.”

content: Omi men woniyamai sabu sinisigoem mes: “Omi tuturam asi yawas komasis mat wonikaita wonbibib on arimon omi ami yawas obis on sinikomasen.”
Omi ami not wonrubunagen tiwag ato bobo komasis wofofour on wonikiriren; yabin omi sabu fani nan on men segogoi God an eta yabin bag sinsagob—ato atonio dura abikakafun on omi animamaiim mes.
Usit Sinbobaimisiren Men
Baise orot tani arimon initetemim inau, “Sabu rabobis on mamaba sinmisiririn men? Ato osi usis on arimon mamaba sinmatar?”
Omi ojim! Fesi aifan motobai ebofefes on, fesi efifim weie ekukubou egeg.
Fesi motobai ebofefes on, men usin engon etatanum on, asir fesi foun wat, tait sawareg fesi o fesi tani.
Baise God on usin ebitai, On egogoi nanaba ato On fesi fous magis magis On Toun ekesin usis ta ta mabis mabis ebites.
Ot usit biot engon on magis magis, orot jever usis bios on magis kaita, bobaitu usis bios on magis tani, kiwiu usis bios on magis tani, a iyan usis bios on magis tani.
Ato safamai mat usis a tafanamai mat usis; baise safamai usis asi kudidiris on magis kaita, ato tafanamai usis asi kudidiris on magis ta.
Wera an kudidirin on magin kaita, roke an kudidirin on magin tani a siribod asi kudidiris on magis tani; a siribod kakaita kakaita asi kudidiris on eb magis ta ta.
Sabu rabob emon sinmisiririn men min arimon on nanaba. Usin ato sigagarob on inkomas inafim, ato usin ato inmimisir men on arimon men inafim;
usin ato sigagarob on men obin on, ato usin inmimisir men on obin baiduduranin imatar; usin sigagarob on samisamin, ato usin inmimisir men on faiwarin bag;
usin maiauin on sigarob, ato usin ayuai nan on inmisir men. On yabinai usit maiauin wat siyamai on nin tafanamai tamama a mat usit ayuai on eb siniyamai nan safamai tanama mes.
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau: “God on orot ainau wabin Adam on ifourai yawasin ima,” baise Keriso on seyoyorai Adam kanfounai on God ifourai inat ayuai nan yawas sabu ebites.
Orot an ayuai on men ainau inat on, baise usit maiauin on ainau inat ato gibui on orot an ayuai on inat.
Orot ainau on tafanam an fofouai nan sifourai, ato orot bairuin on safam emon isur.
Sabu tafanam ebinoanis on, osi on ainau tafanam an orot ba; ato sabu iyabon safam ebinoanis on osi on safam an orot ba.
Ot on tafanam an orot an itin ba on sifourit, on mes on bobo gibui on ot mat sinfourit safam an orot ba tanmatar.
Yau taitaiu tutuau, yau dura ankurereb, usit bion a usit tara on men fofonin inan God an Baiaiwab amonai inama on, mat usit ato efifim on men fofonin ato efanai nan inen au wantoan on.
Omi wontatam, yau dura buburin ankasonem: Ot on men engon tanarab on, baise ot engon arimon tanikitabiret magit tani tanmatar—

on bobo on arimon sasasan wat inmatar, ato matat etafufusin ba, ato dour sinbabain on ebiyoboet wera kanfoun on igat nono. Dour sinbabain ato sabu iyabon sirabob nono on arimon sinmisiririn men sinama au wantoan, ato ot yawasit ari tafanamai tamama on arimon tanikitabiret magit tani tanmatar.
Ot usit ari atonio nin tamama on inarab a inafim ato inikitabirai usit tani inmatar men inarab a men inafim, arimon nana inen au wantoan.

On bobo engon inmatar sabu rabobis sinmisiririn men usis bobous sinboai a sabu ari semama on usis sinikitabires, namon God an dura buk amonai sigayam yen on innat inidura bag: “God on rabob isowarai au wantoan.”

content.text: God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, “Rabob, om am faiwar menan yen sabu unbomerubes? Rabob om am faiwar menan yen sabu unikomasis?”

content: Sabu asi bokomas on rabob faiwar ebitai sabu ebikomasis, ato God an Baifafaro on sabu asi bokomas sifofour on ebiyoboes onai osi bobo aifan sifofour on men fofonin on emon sinayai sinyawas on.
Baise ot on God tabikakaiwai! Ati Bada Iesu Kerisoai on rabob an sowar itet.

On mes yau taitaiu tutuau, omi wonfaskikin tiwag. Omi men woniyamai bobo aifan tani iniyuyunem mes. Omi ra fufur toum ami yawas tutufinai wonkutetim Bada an bobo aurin, yabin omi wosagob ami bobo Bada aurin wobobo on men yabin wagan wat on.
